title: Evidence: Provenance Documentation
submitted_text:
I purchased this Boba Fett figure as part of a vintage Star Wars lot from an estate sale in Portland, OR in November 2023. The lot included 24 loose vintage figures, all original Kenner, from a collector who purchased them new in the late 1970s and early 1980s.

Receipt from Multnomah Estate Services showing lot purchase on November 8, 2023. Lot described as "Vintage Star Wars Kenner action figures, approx 24 pieces with accessories."

Kenner manufactured Boba Fett blasters in multiple production runs with slight variations in plastic composition and mold quality. The plastic texture variation the buyer notes is consistent with known production variation between Hong Kong and Taiwan runs — both are genuine Kenner. The VintageToysAuth authentication confirmed all components as original.

All figures from this lot were stored in a sealed plastic bin with silica gel packets. No exposure to sunlight, moisture, or temperature extremes.
